about: Smart quotes in English, German, French and Russian, dashes, an ellipsis, a ~ non-breaking space, a markup escape, regex metacharacters, emoji (one with joiners) and a soft hyphen in the source (#5 #19).

files.content:
= Typography

He said "hello" --- and 'bye' -- then... done.

Dr.~Smith met Mr. Jones at 5:30.

Cost (USD) \$5 + tax 🙂 [today]? a|b and C++.

A family 👨‍👩‍👧 emoji and a soft hy­phen inside.

#text(lang: "de")[Er sagte "hallo Freunde" und ging.]

#text(lang: "fr")[Il a dit "bonjour les amis" puis partit.]

#text(lang: "ru")[Он сказал "привет друзья" и ушёл.]
